'''Teacher''' skill is improved during [[military]] [[training]] sessions, notably during demonstrations that the dwarf leads. Dwarves with a relatively high [[combat skill]] will organize demonstrations in order to pass the knowledge to other squad members, who gain [[student]] skill. Presumably, [[experience|higher levels]] of these skills facilitate faster learning.
